name: Freshsales
title: freshworks.com
shortDescription: Freshsales is an AI-powered sales CRM designed to enhance productivity and increase conversions. It's tailored for businesses aiming to streamline their sales process and improve customer engagement. Users can manage leads, automate tasks, and gain insights from AI-driven analytics. An example use case involves a sales team using Freshsales to track customer interactions and prioritize leads based on intent scores, significantly reducing time spent on manual tasks and focusing on high-value activities.
pros: AI-driven insights for better lead management
cons: Potential learning curve for new users
May require integration with other tools
Higher pricing tiers might be expensive for small businesses
